title: Generated serving Dockerfile Java setup: install openjdk-<ver>-jdk-headless, not the full JDK, and keep JAVA_HOME fixed
answers: Why did the generated model serving image shrink or lose AWT/Swing after the Java flavor change?
Which apt package does the Java setup step install in the generated Dockerfile for MLflow serving images?
Where is the JAVA_HOME and openjdk install line for the Java flavor built in the Dockerfile generator?
How do I change the JDK version or package used in the generated serving image without breaking javac, java, or mvn?
body:
Path: mlflow/models/docker_utils.py:generate_dockerfile builds the Dockerfile for generated model-serving images. When Java support is requested (the Java flavor / Maven path), its "# Setup Java" block is produced here, and the JDK version comes from MLFLOW_DOCKER_OPENJDK_VERSION.
Rule: the Java setup step installs `openjdk-{jdk_ver}-jdk-headless maven` with `--no-install-recommends` (not `openjdk-{jdk_ver}-jdk`), and still sets `ENV JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-{jdk_ver}-openjdk-amd64`. The headless package provides the same javac, java and mvn under that path. Change the package name only inside setup_java_steps in generate_dockerfile, and update the matching Java lines in the pinned fixtures under tests/resources/dockerfile/ (Dockerfile_java_flavor, Dockerfile_no_model_uri, Dockerfile_conda, Dockerfile_sagemaker_*), which the tests compare against.
Constraints: applies to MLflow-generated Ubuntu serving images with Java only. The headless JDK does not ship GUI toolkits, so AWT and Swing classes are absent in these images; a workload that needs them must bring its own base image or install the full JDK. Does not affect custom user base images that the generator does not build.
applies: Generated model-serving Dockerfiles produced by mlflow/models/docker_utils.py for Java/Maven content on Ubuntu bases; not custom user-supplied base images.
says: Java model serving containers fail with missing windowing and graphic toolkit errors.
Reduce the download size of deployment containers generated for Java model serving.
Deployed Java models crash when attempting to load desktop rendering libraries inside containers.
Allow deploying Java models that depend on graphical user interface frameworks.
search: Generated model serving Dockerfile creation in mlflow/models/docker_utils.py:generate_dockerfile installs openjdk-{jdk_ver}-jdk-headless and maven without recommended packages while setting JAVA_HOME to /usr/lib/jvm/java-{jdk_ver}-openjdk-amd64. The JDK version is controlled by MLFLOW_DOCKER_OPENJDK_VERSION, and updates require syncing test fixtures in tests/resources/dockerfile/Dockerfile_*. Because the headless package omits GUI toolkits like AWT and Swing, workloads requiring them must supply custom base images or install the full JDK.
